Job Summary

Senior QA Automation Engineer – works with limited guidance to design, develop, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and suites for medium to high complexity systems, ensuring high quality and reliability of deliverables. Partners closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and DevOps/Infra teams to drive test strategy, automation coverage, and continuous testing as part of CI/CD pipelines. Provides technical leadership within the QA function, mentors junior team members, contributes to estimation and risk identification, and influences improvements in quality engineering practices, tools, and processes.

Job Responsibilities

- Own and evolve test automation strategy and frameworksfor assigned applications and platforms, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and reusability.
- Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites(UI, API, integration, and regression) for medium to high complexity features and systems.
- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, enabling continuous testing, fast feedback, and quality gates as part of build and release processes.
- Work closely with BAs, Product Owners, and Developers to review requirements and designs, identify test conditions early, and ensure functional and non‑functional requirements are testable.
- Lead efforts to maintain and optimize regression test packs, ensuring appropriate coverage of critical business flows and minimizing flakiness.
- Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and collaborate with development and DevOps teams to identify root causesand drive timely defect resolution.
- Contribute to and sometimes lead non‑functional testingactivities (e.g., performance, reliability, basic security checks) using approved tools and practices.
- Mentor and support junior QA engineers, providing guidance on test design, automation practices, coding standards, and quality mindset.
- Influence and improve QA and engineering processes, standards, and tooling (e.g., coding guidelines for test automation, code review practices for test assets).
- Participate actively in Agile ceremonies(planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives), providing input on test effort, quality risks, and readiness for release.
- Produce and maintain clear documentationof test frameworks, automation approaches, test plans, and test execution reports for stakeholders.

Skills And Experience

- 6+ years of strong hands‑on experience with modern test automation frameworksfor web/UI testing (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, WebDriverIO, or equivalent).
- Solid experience testing and automating REST APIs(e.g., Postman with Newman, REST Assured, Karate, or similar).
- Proficiency in at least one programming languageused for automation (e.g., Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python), including good coding practices and refactoring skills.
- Practical experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD tools(e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) with build, test, and deployment pipelines.
- Strong understanding of software testing principlesand techniques (functional, integration, regression, exploratory, boundary, negative testing, etc.).
- Working knowledge of relational databases(e.g., SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and ability to write moderate‑complexity SQL for data setup and validation.
- Experience with version control systems(e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows (branches, pull requests, code reviews).
- Exposure to or experience with performance testing tools(e.g., JMeter, Gatling, k6) and analysis of performance results is a plus.
- Familiarity with BDD/TDD approachesand tools (e.g., Cucumber, SpecFlow, Behave) is desirable.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrumenvironments and collaborating with cross‑functional teams (Dev, QA, DevOps, Product, BA).

About Us

Dymon Asia Capital (“Dymon Asia”), founded in 2008, is a leading alternative investment firm with assets across public and private markets. The firm’s flagship hedge fund product is the Multi-Strategy Investment Fund (MSIF), an Asia-focused multi-manager multi-strategy fund that seeks to generate absolute consistent uncorrelated returns from emerging and developed markets.

Headquartered in Singapore, Dymon Asia operates from nine offices across the Middle East and Asia, including Hong Kong, Tokyo, Dubai, Shanghai, Mumbai, and Kuala Lumpur. Our platform is built on our people. We bring together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experience across our multi-strategy and private markets businesses. Maintaining a collaborative culture where our people are set up to do their best work is central to how we operate.

We are looking for a Senior SDET / QA Automation Engineer to lead quality engineering across our data platform. This role is suited to a hands-on engineer who builds automation rather than executes manual tests, and who wants to ensure the data behind trading, risk and investment decisions is accurate, reliable and performant.

Working closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers and Developers, you will embed automated testing within each sprint and validate large-volume pipelines built with Python, PySpark and modern Lakehouse technologies.

- Design and implement automated functional, regression, integration and performance tests for data platforms and pipelines.
- Develop and maintain test automation using Python and PySpark.
- Validate data ingestion, transformations and processing through data quality, source-to-target reconciliation and business-rule validation.
- Work closely with Data Architects and Developers to define test coverage and identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle.
- Deliver test automation within the sprint, alongside feature development.
- Build reusable, maintainable automation frameworks and integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
- Test large-volume data processing for performance, scalability and reliability.
- Investigate data discrepancies, defects and performance issues, working with engineering teams to identify root causes.
- Contribute to sprint planning, refinement and technical discussions, promoting testability and quality engineering practices.

Job Requirements

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline preferred.
- 6+ years of experience in SDET, QA Automation, Quality Engineering or a similar hands-on technical testing role, with a proven track record of developing automated tests rather than primarily executing manual testing.
- Strong experience testing data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses/lakes or other data-intensive systems, including data quality, reconciliation and transformation validation.
- Strong programming and test automation skills in Python, with hands-on PySpark experience testing large datasets.
- Strong SQL skills for data validation and analysis.
- Experience building maintainable automated test suites and frameworks and implementing them within CI/CD pipelines; pytest or similar Python testing frameworks preferred.
- Experience across functional, regression, integration and performance testing, including scalability and high-volume data testing, within Agile teams using a shift-left, in-sprint automation approach.
- Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Developers and Architects.
- Domain exposure highly desirable: hedge funds, asset management, investment banking or capital markets, including familiarity with financial datasets such as trades, positions, market data, P&L and risk data.
- Exposure to Databricks and Lakehouse platforms, Delta Lake and Spark-based processing, Azure, AWS or GCP, data quality/observability or orchestration tools, and data governance, lineage and metadata concepts is a plus.

Each implementation may have different client requirements, configurations, content, functionality and design specifications requiring strong attention to detail, sound testing judgement and proactive communication.

Reports to: QA Engineer Lead – Delivery QA

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Implementation Testing

- Perform QA validation throughout the delivery lifecycle including Preview, Soft Launch, Production Launch, defect retesting, maintenance and regression testing.
- Validate functionality against requirements, scope and approved specifications.
- Perform visual and design validation against approved designs.
- Perform responsive/mobile and cross-browser testing.
- Perform accessibility testing using appropriate automated and manual techniques including tools such as Axe DevTools, WAVE and Lighthouse, as well as keyboard and screen-reader testing where required.
- Perform CMS and content-management validation, including configuration, content behaviour and editor functionality.
- Verify copy and content against approved source material.
- Perform multilingual verification where applicable.
- Identify, document and communicate defects, risks and testing concerns clearly.

Defect Management & Collaboration

- Document defects clearly in BugHerd including reproduction steps, evidence, severity and relevant context.
- Work closely with DPM, Development and Implementation/Configuration teams to clarify issues and support resolution.
- Communicate testing progress, blockers, risks and dependencies proactively.
- Raise missing requirements, access issues or scope concerns that may prevent effective testing.
- Manage assigned QA activities and priorities across multiple concurrent implementations.
- Take ownership of assigned work, plan testing activities proactively and ensure work is completed within agreed timelines.

QA Improvement & Automation

- Follow established Delivery QA processes, standards and readiness requirements.
- Contribute to improvements in QA processes, documentation, tools and ways of working.
- Identify repetitive and predictable testing activities that may be suitable for automation.
- Participate in evaluating QA automation initiatives and provide feedback on accuracy, usability and suitability for Delivery QA.
- Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the QA team.

Required

Qualifications & Experience

- 2+ years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance/testing.
- Strong experience with manual testing of web applications.
- Experience with functional, visual, responsive and cross-browser testing.
- Sound testing judgement and ability to assess risks, priorities and testing scope across different implementations.
- Experience identifying, documenting and retesting defects.
- Experience using defect-management tools such as BugHerd or equivalent.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify functional, visual and content-related issues.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple concurrent assignments.
- Ability to proactively identify and communicate blockers, risks and dependencies.
- Comfortable working in a delivery environment where requirements and implementation scope may vary between projects.

Preferred

- Experience testing client-facing websites or digital experiences preferably in a delivery environment.
- Experience with accessibility testing and tools such as Axe DevTools, WAVE, Lighthouse or NVDA and working knowledge of WCAG.
- Experience with CMS or content-management systems.
- Experience with mobile/responsive web testing.
- Experience with multilingual website testing.
- Experience using BrowserStack or similar cross-browser/device testing platforms.
- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS and browser developer tools.
- Exposure to QA automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium or Cypress.

Work Location

Hybrid Work Model: This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week.

Company Values

Innovative Spirit — Innovation leads the way. We have a rich history of developing and delivering what's new and next while valuing every voice on our team. Together, we're shaping the future and leading the industry forward.

Supportive Teams — Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities.

We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive.
